entities.summary: Åshild Bruun-Gundersen, formerly Åshild Haugland, is a Norwegian politician for the Progress Party. She served as a deputy representative to the Parliament of Norway from Aust-Agder during the term 2009–2013. and was elected representative to the Storting from the constituency of Aust-Agder for the period 2017–2021. She has been a member of Arendal municipal council.
